title: 道教护佑佩饰
summary: 让传统纹样贴近日常，以随身佩饰寄托守护与安宁的心意。
summary_en: A Taoist pendant for everyday wear, carrying a traditional wish for protection and peace.
body:
一枚随身佩饰，也是一份可被记起的心意。阳翥道教护佑佩饰依道教科仪与传统准备，以道教文化纹样为主题，便于在日常佩戴中表达对传统的珍视与对平安的祈愿。

「护佑」与「辟邪」描述的是道教信仰中的传统寓意，并非对现实效果的承诺。不同图案各有文化主题，可以先欣赏图库中的款式，再向协会了解适合自己的选择。

无论是为自己留一份心意，还是赠予亲友，都可以从纹样的文化主题开始选择。图库展示多种设计，一份订单不包含全部款式；购买前请与协会确认所选纹样、材质、尺寸、配件和配送安排。
body_en:
A pendant can hold a small, personal connection to tradition. Prepared according to Taoist rituals and traditions, Yangzhu's Taoist Evil-Warding & Protection Pendant is intended for everyday wear, expressing respect for Taoist culture and a wish for peace.

“Protection” and “evil-warding” describe traditional religious symbolism, rather than a promise of practical results. Each motif has a distinct cultural theme; explore the gallery designs and ask the Association about your preferred choice.

Whether chosen for yourself or as a gift, each design begins with a cultural story. The gallery shows several motifs; one order does not include every pictured design. Confirm your selected motif, materials, dimensions, accessories and delivery arrangements with the Association before purchase.

faq:
问：可以选择图片中的某个图案吗？
答：请在付款前联系协会确认所需纹样及供货情况；各款式展示页提供相应的咨询入口。

问：一份订单包含所有挂件吗？
答：不是。图库展示不同纹样，实际订单内容请与协会确认。

问：护佑与辟邪是什么意思？
答：这是道教信仰中对平安与守护的传统表达，属于文化与宗教寓意，不代表对具体结果的保证。
faq_en:
Q: Can I choose one of the pictured designs?
A: Contact the Association before payment to confirm your preferred motif and its availability. Each design page includes an inquiry link.

Q: Does one order include every pictured pendant?
A: No. The gallery shows different designs. Confirm the contents of your order with the Association.

Q: What do protection and evil-warding mean here?
A: They express traditional Taoist aspirations for peace and protection. They describe religious and cultural meanings, not guaranteed outcomes.
